text: The purpose of this report is to obtain approval for the installation/removal of on-street accessible parking spaces for persons with disabilities. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit service on the subject streets, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on February 26, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation and removal of on-street accessible parking spaces at the locations identified in Appendix A to the report (January 28, 2019) from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
